title: CME’s share of XRP futures jumps as token rallies 40% in a week
summary: Outstanding XRP futures positions outside CME fell by more than 500 million tokens in two weeks, while exposure on the regulated U.S. exchange climbed about 36% as XRP rallied toward $1.40.
